name: Privatzimmer Edtbauer
beschreibung: The Gasthof Edtbauer is located in the town centre of Ebbs in the Tiroler Unterland. The house rents out private rooms and offers simple, well-kept accommodation. The location is well suited for guests who want to explore the northern Tiroler Bergwelt – the Kaisergebirge is nearby. The atmosphere is traditional and rustic, typical of a rural inn in the region. Guests can expect straightforward hospitality and authentic accommodation.
